lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct high-contrast vertical lines; inter-line spacing is wider in the mid-torso region and decreases significantly towards the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The most anterior line is abbreviated, terminating in the upper third of the torso. Two posterior lines terminate prematurely before reaching the ventral hair fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two isolated high-contrast white spots are visible on the upper posterior haunch.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a lyrate spiral trajectory, curving posteriorly and then medially-upward from the skull base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is 3.2 times the width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory tipping represents approximately 15% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white dorsal crest extending from the neck to the rump and a long, dark shaggy ventral hair fringe.
